en.bdb: The drop of the cup of love

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਲਹਿਰ ਤਰੰਗਾ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal lakh lakh lakh lahir tara(n)gaa|

en.bdb: The gurmukhs identify the wave of delightful fruit among the illusionary waves of the world ocean.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਸਮਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਲਖ ਲਹਰੀ ਅੰਗਾ।
verses.translit_en: lakh dhareeaau samaau kar lakh laharee a(n)gaa|

en.bdb: They bear upon their body millions of waves of worldly rivers.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਖ ਤੀਰਥ ਗੰਗਾ।
verses.translit_en: lakh dhareeaau samu(n)dh vich lakh teerath ga(n)gaa|

en.bdb: Myriads of rivers are there in the ocean and likewise many are pilgrimage centres on the Ganges.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਗੜਾੜ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਰੰਗਾ।
verses.translit_en: lakh samu(n)dh gaRaaR vich bahu ra(n)g bira(n)gaa|

en.bdb: In the oceans are millions of sea of varying forms and hues.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਗੜਾੜ ਤਰੰਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਖ ਅਝੁ ਕਿਣੰਗਾ।
verses.translit_en: lakh gaRaaR tara(n)g vich lakh ajh kina(n)gaa|

en.bdb: Such oceans may be visualized in one drop of the tears of love.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਪੀਵਣਾ ਕੋ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਚੰਗਾ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit_en: piram piaalaa peevanaa ko buraa na cha(n)gaa ||10||

en.bdb: Nothing is good or bad for the man who quaffs from the cup of love.
